systems.tiers: data collected from schools up through woreda and regional bureaux; analysed and disseminated at national and regional level
an intended intervention under ESDP VI
proposed, to be integrated with or supported by EMIS

systems.system: School Net Cloud / National Education Cloud
systems.tiers: data centre and network operation centre established; learning management system not yet functional; private cloud in 300 secondary schools and 10 universities under GEQIP II

note: The April 2023 compact describes EMIS as regular data collection feeding the annual abstract, still largely paper-based, and states as a need not yet met that it be fully digitised with students and teachers identified by unique IDs; it describes no per-learner record entered by schools, so EMIS is census here and gives no fact. SMIS, TMIS and GIS are named without description.
